- [Storefront Themes](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/themes.md): Storefront Themes: Storefront Themes let you customize the visual appearance of the Shopware Storefront. They are not a separate extension type, but are either implemented as plugins or, in Cloud environments, delivered via apps.
